channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Rising Crimes And Farmer’s Plight Dominate Conversations at 60th Shiv Sena (UBT) Dussera Rally
item.description: In a separate bid, the Eknath Shinde-led faction staged its own event in Goregaon, as rally participants urged accountability from officials and warned of political consequences if justice for students amid recent paper leaks is not delivered

item.title: Left parties should sell books from party offices, not at Durga Puja pandals, says West Bengal CM
item.description: The remarks by the Chief Minister, Suvendu Adhikari, come at a time after a section of leaders of his own party condemned attacks on the book stalls set up by the Left parties at Durga Puja pandals

item.title: Dasara gift for Singareni officers, Dy CM fulfils long-pending demand
item.description: Singareni management issued orders on evening of October 19 implementing the revised pay structure after securing the approval of the company’s Board. The orders were issued by Director (Personnel) Gautam Potru

item.title: Rubio pushes for India to buy more U.S., Venezuelan oil
item.description: S. Jaishankar hosts U.S. Secretary of State, UAE FM in Mumbai, holds trilateral talks on trade, energy, and connectivity

item.title: Bengal CM defends decision to shift stampede injured to private hospital, cites better care
item.description: "We moved those injured to private hospitals because we realised that the best treatment could be provided there so that there is no more loss of life. I am happy to announce that there was no death among the 25 injured in the stampede. We decided on the spot. There is nothing controversial behind this," says West Bengal CM

item.title: Chennai Mayor alleges online harassment; lodges complaint with police
Haryana power staff call 3-day strike against giving licence to private discom
item.description: HERC grants Eleven Power 25-year licence to distribute power in Gurugram, Nuh; Power Minister says State will contest move before tribunal; staff allege decision will ‘undermine’ State-owned firm

item.title: One dead, few injured in firing inside SGNP
item.description: The incident occurred in the SGNP's Chena beat in the Yeoor Range, Thane, police said. After being alerted, forest department personnel along with police teams rushed to the spot for inspection

item.title: Guest lecturers yet to get hike in honorarium announced in the budget
item.description: Higher Education Minister had announced in Assembly that the honorarium for guest lecturers would be hiked by ₹5,000 to ₹35,000

item.title: Thermal power plants must undergo annual fly ash audits, CPCB submits before NGT
item.description: The submission followed an NGT order on a petition filed by the Tamil Nadu Fly Ash Brick and Blocks Manufacturers Association, which had sought clarity on the CPCB’s role in conducting regular audits of fly ash generated by thermal power plants

item.title: Kashmir clerics, including Mirwaiz, say eviction of Delhi’s historic Race Course mosque ‘deeply disturbing’
item.description: “If even a legally recognised mosque cannot be protected, what safeguards remain for others?” says Mirwaiz

item.title: The ECI’s unfinished lessons
item.description: While the ECI need not accept every allegation made by political parties, constitutional authority cannot substitute for verifiable evidence

item.title: Health Minister directs officials to ensure hospital preparedness, uninterrupted health services during monsoon
item.description: The Minister says that all districts are instructed to take up precautionary measures to achieve three objectives of preventing the spread of diseases during the monsoon, preventing deaths and ensuring uninterrupted medical services

item.title: On paddy field conservation in Keralam
item.description: Neglecting paddy fields as a socio-ecological system that regulates local biodiversity, the hydrological cycle, and microclimate constitutes a grave failure, amid rising food insecurity and floods

item.title: At Dussehra rally, Uddhav bats for 'regime change', promises 'acche din' after ousting BJP
item.description: Addressing the annual Dussehra rally at Shivaji Park in Mumbai, Mr. Thackeray insisted that staging a protest is the right of youth because 'vote chori' (vote theft) is happening with everyone, especially new voters

item.title: 30-foot-high cockroach effigy triggers AAP-BJP war of words
item.description: “Deliberate alteration of Sanatan customs and hurting of religious sentiments: The festival of Dussehra, or Vijayadashami, is a highly sacred event governed by ancient Hindu rituals, scriptures and longstanding traditions

item.title: T.N. government should construct new Secretariat complex outside Chennai, says Anbumani
item.description: He wants the State government to clarify whether the media reports about constructing the Secretariat at Pallavan Illam are true

item.title: Fresh weather system likely to sustain heavy rainfall in Tamil Nadu till October 26
item.description: The RMC has issued orange alerts for a few southern districts, including Tirunelveli and Thoothukudi, as they may receive heavy to very heavy rainfall up to 20 cm on October 21 and 22

item.title: AAP claims Punjab CM Mann detained for three hours at Delhi airport, fined ₹50,000
item.description: In a statement, Mr. Pannu accused the Centre of creating “obstacles” in the path of Punjab’s progress

item.title: In Delhi, only 0.27% of 4.5 lakh Form 6s disposed of so far
item.description: Of 4.5 lakh applications for inclusion, about 2.39 lakh were filed by those seeking re-inclusion or applying for the first time after the draft roll was published

item.title: CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke thanks Delhi Ramlila organisers for ‘free publicity’ over cockroach effigy
item.description: The Shree Keshav Ram Leela Committee, which organises the annual event in Pitampura, has said the cockroach effigy is intended to symbolise filth and dirt and promote cleanliness under the Swachh Bharat and Swachh Delhi campaigns

item.title: Keralam seeks FSSAI clarity on high fat, sugar, salt food
item.description: The State will strengthen all legal measures to curb unhealthy eating habits among children and prevent excessive consumption of junk food, says Health Minister K. Muraleedharan

item.title: U.S.-India perfectly aligned on core issues: Marco Rubio
item.description: After laying a wreath at the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, S. Jaishankar says India expects its partners to show ‘zero tolerance’ towards terrorism

item.title: Dussehra celebrated in Belagavi
item.description: Family members of the Patils of the old city performed the pooja. They received various palanquins carrying revered deities such as Venkatramna, Maruti, Jotiba, and the Aapti tree

item.title: Health Department issues circular on maintaining medicine stocks in hospitals
item.description: The circular directs that an updated list of the medicine stocks in hospitals be provided to doctors in the OP (outpatient) departments. This will help doctors have a clear idea about the medicines available in the hospital and to prescribe the same to patients.

item.title: Newsprint makers seek PM Modi's intervention over coal shortages, demand 75:25 allocation ratio
item.description: In a representation to PM Modi, the association sought timely coal dispatches under existing fuel supply agreements with Coal India Limited subsidiaries

item.title: PM Modi flags three ‘enemies’ of India, calls for unity in national interest
item.description: “Let our thoughts be aligned… all the institutions of the nation, all political parties… let us stand together for the national interest. We must proceed with this very spirit; we must fight together against the enemies of the country,” Prime Minister Narendra Modi said

item.title: Pinarayi Vijayan questions SMA drug distribution; SAT Hospital says only CDSCO-approved drugs used
item.description: Pinarayi Vijayan said the negligent stance of the Health Minister was criminal and demanded that the Government conduct an enquiry into the incident

item.title: J&K government announces annual shifting of capital from Srinagar to Jammu
item.description: According to the ‘Darbar Move’ calendar, the offices are scheduled to reopen in the winter capital of Jammu on November 2. In summer capital Srinagar, offices will start closing from October 30 and October 31

item.title: Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh completes final IAF sortie in Hyderabad with instructor who first taught him to fly
item.description: Air Chief Marshal Singh undertook his first-ever flying sortie on January 28, 1984

item.title: Police actions on protesters violate India’s core international legal obligations: UN human rights experts
item.description: ‘Any restrictions on peaceful assembly must be legal, pursue a legitimate aim, and be necessary and proportionate,’ says a joint statement by a group of globally recognised rapporteurs, issued by the UN Human Rights Office of the High Commissioner

item.title: On ECINet platform, access for States can be switched off and on centrally: report
item.description: The report assumes significance in view of objections raised by Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi over the centralisation of ECINet and the electoral roll database

item.title: Kanthapuram Sunni faction calls off protests against Waqf board reconstitution in Keralam
item.description: The faction will have a nominee in the board, says Minister Samsudheen

item.title: Arrest made in Sakthikulangara skeletal remains case
item.description: The gruesome incident came to light on September 30 when workers cleaning the harbor's septic tank found decomposed remains concealed beneath a mat

item.title: CJP leaders Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka move Delhi HC against judicial custody
item.description: The CJP leaders have questioned the justification for their continued detention on grounds of public order; their plea states that any restriction on liberty must be backed by a real and proximate connection with a disturbance of public order, rather than a remote possibility of such a disturbance

item.title: West Bengal CM meets families of deceased in Kolkata puja pandal stampede
item.description: Suvendu Adhikari hands over a cheque of ₹25 lakh to relatives and assures government job for one person in every family

item.title: Cardiologists from across the globe discuss angioplasty complications at meet in Chennai
Collector reviews flood mitigation works in Cuddalore
State Highways Dept. to complete widening of BHEL Feeder Road in Ranipet by December
item.description: The project is expected to bring relief to motorists, especially truck drivers, bound for industrial units in the district

item.title: Delhi protest: Judicial custody of Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka extended by two days
item.description: A Special Executive Magistrate observed that their conduct showed that they have no respect for the law and that there are serious concerns about them breaching peace

item.title: Kuki man killed in Manipur; shutdown paralyses Imphal Valley
item.description: A Kuki organisation announces 24-hour shutdown in Kangpokpi district from Tuesday night to express collective anguish and demand justice

item.title: Activists seek Governor’s intervention for release of people arrested in Odisha’s bauxite region
item.description: Two activists, Randall Sequeira and Laxman Naik, associated with the resistance against Sijimali bauxite mining, were picked up from Bhabanipatna

item.title: L-G would be final authority in proposed U.T.-level body in Ladakh, says Centre’s proposal
item.description: The draft, accessed by The Hindu asks, whether the delimitation of constituencies for the elected body will be done by an election authority or a Delimitation Commission; it also explores multiple options, including reserving one-third or up to 50% of the seats in the proposed body for women

item.title: Dasara festivities add to garbage burden in Tiruchi
item.description: Heaps of garbage were found on Thanjavur Road, Singarathope, NSB Road, Big Bazaar Street, Chinnakadai Street, Nandi Koil Street, and Sathara Veedhi in Srirangam

item.title: President promulgates LAHDC Regulation, paves the way for hill council polls in all eight districts of Ladakh
item.description: L-G Vinai Kumar Saxena says the decision is historic as ‘it was implemented in a record time of just six days and now paves the way for creation of LAHDC in all eight districts of Ladakh, including the newly-created Sankoo district’

item.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper train likely to be launched on November 1
item.description: According to a Railway Board communication accessed by The Hindu, the service has been approved following the minutes of a meeting held on February 16, 2026

item.title: Indian scientists identify Martian analogue sites
item.description: Researchers added that identifying terrestrial analogue sites has become a pressing requirement in the era of intense planetary exploration since recent studies demonstrated that orbital data alone cannot fully characterise Martian minerals.

item.title: Centre must stop treating Punjab's drug crisis as ‘political opportunity’: AAP Minister on Shah’s visit
item.description: Harpal Cheema's reaction came as Amit Shah met the kin of victims of the drug menace in Punjab and said he had come to remind the AAP government and its leaders that they promised to eradicate the drug trade within three months of coming to power, but it is growing

item.title: Traffic along Adimaly-Munnar stretch of Kochi-Dhanushkodi National Highway banned following rockfall
item.description: The ban was imposed after several loose boulders and trees along the roadside were found to pose an immediate safety risk to commuters

item.title: Karnataka HC refuses to drop charge of culpable homicide not amounting murder against father in fatal accident caused by minor son
item.description: Justice M. Nagaprasanna made these observations while dismissing a criminal petition filed by Nadeem of Mysuru, who sought to quash the charge sheet against him

item.title: Naam Tamilar Katchi’s Dharapuram bypoll candidate Karthika arrested
item.description: On October 4, Ms. Karthika and 20 others were detained for staging road blockade protesting denial of permission to conduct their campaign along the roadshow route of CM Vijay. Seeman slams TVK government.

item.title: Greater Bengaluru Authority receives over 1,500 objections to tree felling for Hebbal Short Tunnel
item.description: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) restrained the Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) from felling any trees till the hearing in the case challenging tree felling for the project is completed

item.title: Uttar Pradesh elections: Samajwadi Party to release election manifesto on November 26
item.description: It will include separate documents for women, youth and a manifesto on law and order, highlighting party’s commitment on these issues apart from focus on social justice and PDA plank

item.title: How Tamil actor M.R. Radha got away with staging a ‘banned’ play in 1959
item.description: The Madras Government, in April 1959, banned popular actor M.R. Radha’s Tamil play Thooku Medai. He submitted the script of another drama Kathal Bali to the Madras Commissioner of Police and obtained a licence to perform it. On noticing that the play was similar to the banned Thooku Medai, the police registered a case.

item.title: Mohan Bhagwat warns against agitations that divide, urges unity rooted in ‘Hindu spirit’
item.description: When a protest becomes a political instrument driven by hostility towards a person, group or ideology, forces seeking to keep India subdued take advantage of the situation, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’s head says

item.title: Kharge to apprise Modi of concerns over SIR, delimitation and women’s reservation
item.description: AICC President Mallikarjun Kharge said he would apprise Prime Minister Narendra Modi of his concerns over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the proposed delimitation exercise and the implementation of women’s reservation during their interaction on Wednesday (October 21).

item.title: Sugarcane farmers crisis: Karnataka CM Shivakumar seeks Centre’s intervention
item.description: State will fulfil some of their demands, says Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar

item.title: Amit Shah visits Punjab; drug menace at centre stage yet again
item.description: Home Minister accuses the AAP government of doing nothing concrete to eradicate the problem

item.title: Vijay announces ₹30 lakh for Asian Para Games medal winners from T.N.
item.description: Jehan Dorab Madan and Sahana Ravi both won bronze medals in table tennis at the event being held in Japan

item.title: Samiti urges Centre to appoint Kannadiga as Central University Vice-Chancellor
item.description: Kalyana Karnataka Pratyeka Rajya Horata Samiti has urged the Union government to appoint a qualified academician from Karnataka as Vice-Chancellor of the Central University of Karnataka (CUK) at Kadaganchi, on the outskirts of Kalaburagi
